_about: The ALERT at the end of each sol's plan. A countdown (duration, in real seconds) starts when the player taps Ready. Time Points do not apply: walking costs walkSecondsPerRoom real seconds per room, each fix takes `work` seconds, and normal room actions take actionWorkSeconds. Each alert has 3 problems; the numbers are set so 2 can be fixed but never all 3 (a choice, not a speed test). A problem with preparedBy / preparedIf is already fixed if the player did that in the plan. effect = what happens if the problem is not fixed (GAME-SIZED). Check with: npm run balance.

settle.title: Power dip
settle.problem: Power dip! Three machines just switched off.
settle.goal: You can restart two. Which matter most?

threats.savedText: The air maker is running again.

threats.missText: The plants sat in the dark.
threats.savedText: The grow lamps are back on.

threats.missText: A cold restart drained the battery.

dust.title: Dust on the panels
dust.problem: A dust gust! Dust is piling up fast.
dust.goal: Brush the panels, or protect the machines.

threats.preparedText: You cleaned the panels this morning, so the gust slid off.
threats.missText: More dust stuck to the panels.

flare.title: Solar flare
flare.problem: Flare alert! Radiation reaches Mars when the timer ends.
flare.goal: Boost the shield, or protect the plants and the air maker.

threats.preparedText: Your shield is already as strong as the flare!

plants.title: Cold plants
plants.problem: A cold snap! The greenhouse is freezing.
plants.goal: Warm the plants, or keep the rest of the base warm.

threats.preparedText: The grow lights kept the plants warm.

threats.missText: The cold slowed the air maker.

threats.task: Make hot soup for the crew
threats.missText: Cold crew, so the heaters worked extra hard.

airmaker.title: Air maker slows down
airmaker.problem: Air alarm! The air maker is slowing down.
airmaker.goal: Fix it fast, or patch the leak and save power.

threats.preparedText: You fixed the air maker this morning!
threats.missText: The air maker made less air.
The main battery lost some power.

message.title: Late message
message.problem: Old message from Earth: "Raise the shield, a flare is coming!"
message.goal: It left Earth minutes ago. Trust it, or fix what is broken now?
message.afterNote: The flare Earth saw already passed. Their message was old by the time it arrived.

threats.savedText: You raised the shield, just in case.

storm.title: Big dust storm
storm.problem: The big storm hits! Everything is in danger.
storm.goal: Save power, air or food. You cannot save all three.

threats.missText: The storm shook the panels loose.
Storm dust got into the air maker.
